observations: Matte opaque cobalt-blue clay body and cream thick raised title on saturated orange are maintained.
All Korean copy is raised, with smaller shallow blue lettering for information; numerals and URL also have raised clay edges.
Native PNG manifest measures equal edges; no native rescale or crop is performed by preservation.
One thick blue body links both arms through the fully visible lower torso, enclosing a real orange gap.
Wide flattened left inner patch and flat right side memory patch have local creases leading into rounded surrounding volume.
At usage720 and thumbnail320 the non-glyph blue body is a large visible structure; it is not replaced by lettering or token ornament.
The left pressed tip is flatter and right arm's top is more domed; action remains an interpreted static moment rather than a sequence.
Title has open ㅁ and ㅇ counters and visible space between 내 and 모양.
Subtitle retains all Hangul syllables, and word boundaries in its two lines are visible.
The event second row preserves a perceptible space between 메이커 and 데이 but its syllables remain tall/narrow.
Title 양 is close to the right inner arm; its strokes are not overlapped.
Subtitle now occupies the mouth of the gap above the title, between the upper clay ends.
Cream title remains within the actual orange interior, in two readable rows.
Right block groups event, date/time, place and application using common alignment, with legible individual entries at usage720.
Event and URL remain near right edge; the smallest URL loses reliable transcription at thumbnail320.
Single cream plate hovers above the left shoulder; its handle is cropped at top.
The plate underside and broad compressed left inner face are not perfectly aligned; the pressure direction is partly indicated by plate proximity and converging folds.
Right arm is materially connected to the lower torso and has rounded volume above a flat side memory patch.
Soft upper-left highlights and lower/right cast shadows are consistent across body and lettering.
Clay surface is matte, with fold ridges located at pressed left tip and lower/right joins.
Fine textured crease network still spans broad rounded blue surfaces; cream plate has similar fine tooling roughness.
No observed added logos, watermarks, fake labels, tiny ornaments or separate before/after body.

located_observations.observation: Subtitle was moved from below title to above it, in the actual orange mouth.
Event, place and URL have short right-edge margins and relatively narrow letter proportions.
All six supplied entries are readable; title counters remain distinct.
Connected body and inner cavity remain large and readable as the main form, with title contained inside.

residuals: Right event and URL end close to the poster edge; the requested wider right margin was not achieved.
Event second-row Hangul and URL remain narrow in proportion to their height.
Press plate handle still crosses the top frame and the plate-to-flattened-shoulder force direction remains only partly clear.
The right arm has a rounded top with a large flat side patch; recovery is conveyed by this contrast and continuous creases but can still resemble a sliced curved body.
Broad blue surfaces retain an extensive fine crease/grain network beyond the main pressure zones.
The subtitle sits at the mouth but has tight clearance to the left inner facet; title 양 is close to the right blue arm.
URL is readable at usage720, but cannot be reliably transcribed from thumbnail320.
Only actual native dimensions were measured; maximum output setting and print suitability were not verified.
selection_consideration: Prefer repair-2 for the assigned entrance-to-information relationship and preserved complete continuous body; initial crops the body and lacks distinct event word spacing, while repair-1 leaves subtitle below title. Residual geometric and typography limitations remain explicitly recorded.
